how: Each sheet: the drawn parts laid out in a grid (artExport rigs) uploaded as the first reference, the house style image as the second; cut with build.rig_parts(render, rows, cols, [(name, drawn size)]). folio.f2/f4/f6 copy f0, f3/f5 copy f1, pulper.rollB/legB copy rollA/legA.

lev.prompt:

2 (row 1, column 2). Lower jaw: a thin violet paper jaw strip, about 3.3 times as wide as tall

4 (row 1, column 4). Body segment: a round deep violet paper disc with a lighter inner ring and glossy ink sheen, about 1.0 times as wide as tall

Plain flat light grey background, generous space between pieces, no text, no labels, no shadows, no extra pieces.

human_foes.how: 2 foes per sheet (rows), parts head (face blanked with hface.blank), torso, armA, armB, legA, legB; cut as human@<foe>.<part> with build.rig_parts(render, 2, 6, ...), then each of the 8 head variants is the painted blank head with hface.features() laid over it.
